device.delete_confirm: Delete the device “{device}”? Its collector is revoked; parts, repairs and usage records stay in the logs.
device.field.name: Name
device.status_hint: Fault and under repair are set by Faults & repairs and return to normal when fixed
device.holder_hint: Changing the holder or department is recorded in the holder history. To add a reason, change it in the Holders tab of the details.
device.import.title: Import devices
device.import.intro: Download the template, fill it in and upload it. Every row is checked first (unique numbers; category, department and holder must match); rows with problems are skipped and listed. The holder may be a name or a staff number.
device.part.none: No parts yet. The first report of the collector records them automatically.
device.part.remove_confirm: Remove “{part}”? It stays in the history.
device.part.removed_n: {n} removed part(s), see the history above
device.lic.name: Software / licence
device.lic.expires_hint: Leave empty for perpetual licences; device admins are reminded before expiry
device.lic.hint: Expiry reminders: 30 and 7 days before and on the day at 09:00 by default; change them in System → Reminder rules.
device.holder.dept_hint: Follows the holder's department when empty
device.holder.note_ph: For example: issued, returned, handed over
device.rep.outside_hint: For repairs done outside, e.g. the repair company
device.rep.parts: Replaced parts (optional): old part → new part
device.rep.no_parts: This device has no parts recorded; add them in the device record first if needed.
device.report.title: Report a fault
device.report.hint: Tell the device admins about a problem
device.report.search: Search by number, name or location
device.report.none_found: No devices found. Search by number, name or location.
device.report.sent: Reported; the device admins will handle it
device.mon.usage_hint: One record per collector registration, start-up and daily report
device.mon.usage_empty: No usage records (they start once a collector is installed)
device.mon.a_hint: Created when reported hardware differs from the recorded parts. Confirm to update the parts (with history); ignore to keep them.
device.anomaly.confirm_hint: Parts follow the reported hardware: missing parts are removed, new ones installed (same type = replaced)
device.anomaly.ignore_hint: The recorded parts stay as they are, e.g. a monitor plugged in for a moment
device.mon.clients_intro: The collector is a plain PowerShell script that runs with the PowerShell built into Windows 7 and later; nothing else is installed. Copy the 4 files below to the computer, create a registration code in the Collector tab of the device, then run install.cmd as administrator.
device.mon.scope_intro: Clients collect only the items ticked here, and the server drops anything else. After a change, clients follow the new scope from their next report.
device.item_desc.memory: Model, serial number and size of each module
device.item_desc.disk: Model, serial number and size of internal disks (not USB drives)
device.coll.boundary: Keyboard input, screen, files, browsing and sign-ins are never collected.
device.coll.not_installed: No collector is installed on this device.
device.coll.pending: A registration code is waiting to be used (valid until {at})
device.coll.code_intro: Enter this code when installing the collector on {device}.
device.coll.step1: Copy the 4 collector files (Usage & monitoring → Collector clients) to the computer.
device.coll.step2: Right-click install.cmd, choose “Run as administrator”, and enter the server address and the code.
device.coll.step3: Afterwards it reports 5 minutes after start-up and daily at 10:00; the first report records the parts.
device.coll.code_once: The code is shown only now, works once and is valid for 7 days. Registering again revokes the device's previous client.
device.coll.revoke_confirm: Revoke the collector of “{device}”? Its reports are refused until it registers again.
device.err.asset_taken: This asset number is already used
device.err.holder_ambiguous: Several people are called “{name}”; use the staff number
device.err.not_found: The device does not exist or is scrapped
device.err.part_empty: Enter a model or a serial number
device.err.part_removed: This part has already been removed
device.err.part_row: Each replaced part needs the old part and the new model or serial number
device.err.fault_state: This report has changed; please refresh
device.err.repairer: Choose a repairer or enter an outside repairer
device.err.anomaly_done: This record has already been handled
collector.err.code: The registration code is wrong, used or expired
collector.err.token: The device token is invalid or revoked
collector.err.too_many: Too many attempts; try again in 15 minutes
notify.msg.device_fault_fixed: Your reported device {asset} {device} has been fixed
notify.msg.device_fault_cancelled: Your fault report on {asset} {device} was cancelled: {reason}
notify.msg.device_anomaly: Hardware of {asset} {device} changed ({added} new, {removed} missing parts); please check
rule.desc.license_expire: A licence recorded on a device is about to expire
rule.who.device_admin: Device admins (unit heads when there are none)
